It is the case's LONG-STANDING LIVE-MODEL FLAKINESS, and it is a REAL red of a flaky live case. Evidence, all measured: (1) the case's own history holds 10 reds and 13 greens from 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-27, ALL PRE-WAVE, and FIVE of those reds carry the IDENTICAL signature `attempts=2, noteChars=0, memoryChars=0` (2026-09-17T03-14-09, 03-18-40, 03-29-58; 2026-09-27T21-45-00, 22-05-49) — today's accidental run reproduces exactly that signature; (2) the SAME case on the SAME revision, run PROPERLY through the lane runner 4 minutes later, PASSES: `evidence/dsh-qa/suite-runner/2026-10-07T10-42-03.811Z/result.json` records verdict 'pass', exitCode 0, durationMs 53853, and the case's own `result.json` then carries `files.ok:true, noteChars:251, memoryChars:420`; (3) even that PASSING run needed `attempts=2` with the identical retry note ('attempt 1 did not complete the flow (unproven tools: none; files present: false) — retrying once'), so the flake is in the live model's FIRST attempt completing the flow, not in the sweep; (4) the accidental run's own isolation was CORRECT — `isolation.ok:true, homeSandboxed:true, realWm before:null after:null` (no leak into the real `~/.mpd/workmate`), and its install/dump/live/flow/isolation steps were all ok, so it was not 'run without prerequisites' either; (5) the case's structure is unchanged by the sweep: the step key set and the five-tool flow key set are byte-identical between the pre-wave green run (2026-09-27T22-11-40.595Z) and today's red run, and Lane C's diffstat on the case is +17/-4 lines. CONCLUSION: not a FAIL to bounce — but the case is ~43% red across its lifetime, which is worth its own follow-up task (stabilize the flow assertion or raise the attempt budget); it is PRE-EXISTING and must not be attributed to this wave.
